weak.en: Although the storm destroyed most of the harbour, the fishermen rebuilt their boats within a single season and went back to sea.

problems: "harbour" translated as "பலமான போர்டை" which is incorrect and loses "most of"
'most of the harbour' mistranslated as 'பலமான போர்டை'
Overall sentence is awkward
Transliterations used instead of native words ('சீசன்', 'போர்ட்')

weak.en: The temperature dropped to minus 40 degrees overnight.
weak.text: வெள்ளை இரவுக்கு வெப்பநிலை -40 டிகிரி வரை குறைந்தது.
problems: "வரை" implies "up to" rather than "down to"
"வெள்ளை இரவுக்கு" is incorrect for "overnight"; use "இரவு முழுவதும்" or "இரவு போல்"
Mistranslation of 'overnight' as 'வெள்ளை இரவுக்கு'

weak.en: For thousands of years, the desert hid a secret beneath its sands.

problems: "For thousands of years" rendered as "ஆயிரம் வருடங்களுக்கு" (singular)
'beneath its sands' translated as 'தனது மணலில்' instead of 'மணலுக்கு அடியில்'
'thousands of years' translated as single thousand ('ஆயிரம்')
Slightly unnatural word order
Phrase 'கேட்டுக்கொள்கிறாயா' is awkward; use 'கேட்கிறாயா'
Unnatural verb form: 'கேட்டுக்கிறாயா' sounds awkward for 'Can you hear?'; 'கேட்கிறதா?' is better.
Missing "டாலர்" after 54, awkward phrasing; better "45 டாலர், 54 டாலர் அல்ல"

Time phrase order is ambiguous; "2 மணி 5 நிமிடத்தில்" can be read as a clock time
